title: Duration Input
summary: Parses durations typed many ways and reads them back in words, so 1.5 isn't logged as 1 h 50 min on a timesheet.
description: Parses 1h30, 90m, 1.5h, 1:30 and 2d 4h into one duration read back in words, catches 1.50 typed for 1 h 50 min, and asks whether 1:30 is h:mm or m:ss when the limits can't decide.
catches: 1.50 meant as 1 h 50 min versus 1.5 hours
Ambiguous 1:30 (h:mm or m:ss), asked when limits can't decide
Values outside min and max, with the limit as a fix
Days converted using hoursPerDay (24 by default)
limits: Parses English unit words and abbreviations only
Days are 24 hours by default; set hoursPerDay (e.g. 8) for working days
a11y: Labelled input with the result read back in words
Each interpretation is a button with visible text
